levels.name: Warm Up
levels.teaser: Tutorial room in two halves: jar and Key, two bolt-cutter halves, the chained door and a 3x3 sliding lock.

levels.name: Escape Room
levels.teaser: Jail cell. Book spines, hidden handle, world map jigsaw and the 514 safe.

levels.name: William's Apartment
levels.teaser: City apartment. Card-suit dial lock 727, keypad 2519, 4x4 symbol panel, two bottles and phone code 35721.

levels.name: High School
levels.teaser: Classroom, corridor and trophy cabinet. Arcade maze gives 1590, blackboard cipher, globe 20/17/39, locker panel and hex tiles.

levels.name: Yacht
levels.teaser: One code only: 58137 down the orange life vest opens the steel keypad by the stairs. Four sand jars, the bell shelf, the shark tank and three shelves of bottles fill the rest of the boat.

levels.name: Amusement Park
levels.teaser: Six numbers and a circuit: the blue ticket machine takes 1496, the photo-booth strips give 20 / 67 / 81 for the strength tester, and the ring toss board has to reach 150 before the exit opens.

levels.name: The Game Night Agency
levels.teaser: Safe code 55793 sits on a crumpled note under the board-game shelf, beside the Scrabble box. A 4x4 card board, a fox tangram, slide blocks and six letter notes (H=C, M=T) make up the rest of the office.

levels.name: Log Cabin
levels.teaser: Two codes in one room: 1746 on the desk laptop and 358429 on the door keypad. Eight glass pieces feed the hex panel and the red safe takes a twelve-button paw code.

levels.name: Junkyard
levels.teaser: JWFMI opens the letter lock on the trailer door and 99452 opens the yellow panel beside the crane. The steering maze, the ring puzzle and the crane parts tray fill out the yard.

levels.name: Train Station
levels.teaser: Nothing to crack: the note, the slot number, the chest code 77059 and the cup order are all handed to you, and the work is matching each one to the right object.

levels.name: Lighthouse
levels.teaser: The last lock is a colour pairing, not a number: five fuse colours on a paper match five buttons on the bomb panel. Wheel and Handle, Candle and Lighter, the lettered books and the candle chart fill the two floors.
